name: Hypatia's Hoard
purpose: The user's exam-prep bank (Exam Coach) on their PC: subjects, topics and questions with spaced repetition, quizzes and mock exams in chat, a day-by-day study plan until the exam (reviews, new cards, timed mocks on the weak topics), oral review (the question is read aloud and the spoken answer is transcribed and graded by meaning), answer grading, and a notebook of their own sources with cited answers, study guides, podcast, mind maps and a Socratic tutor. A teacher role adds classes, exams generated from the teacher's bank and sources with citations and versions, rubrics, batch correction with model proposals the teacher confirms, grades and class analysis (student data stays local). The Exam Coach PWA served by the same app shows and syncs the same data.

check.en: Put the question and reference answer in a subject, then read back the oral practice result.
check.es: Registra la pregunta y la respuesta de referencia en una asignatura y vuelve a leer la evaluación oral.

check.en: Run rehearsal_check and read the verdict per slide: each weak slide must reach deck_defects in Cicero with its objection and evidence. When a source the slide cites changed, the answer lists the objections written again (refreshed); those still pending a redraft (pending_redraft) keep their defect in Cicero until a check with the model writes them again.
check.es: Ejecuta rehearsal_check y lee el veredicto por diapositiva: cada diapositiva floja debe llegar a deck_defects de Cicero con su objeción y su evidencia. Si cambió una fuente que cita la diapositiva, la respuesta enumera las objeciones reescritas (refreshed); las que siguen pendientes de reescribir (pending_redraft) conservan su defecto en Cicero hasta que una comprobación con el modelo las reescriba.

notes: HYPATIA_DIR is the Exam Coach repository folder. Keep the app running (python -m hypatia) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server (starting it if needed) and never opens the database. Build the PWA once with `npm run build:hoard` to use it at {APP_URL}.
